verdict.rationale: RudderStack markets 'AI powered chat interfaces' that let business teams 'analyze, segment, and activate data' without data-team bottlenecks, which is the only evidence touching natural-language segment/audience creation, but there is no documentation showing the AI actually drafting a segment definition for review grounded in the real schema — the detailed MCP feature list (errors, transformations, duplicate events, tracking-plan review, Q&A) never mentions audience/segment building. Missing for 10: explicit walkthrough or docs of natural-language audience creation, schema-grounded segment definition generation, and a review/approval step before activation.
